description: This file contains a shell script designed to automate the validation and testing of firewall configurations (specifically for firewalled systems using fw3/fw4). It includes steps to detect firewall variants, check their status, validate syntax, verify default zone policies, and perform temporary allow/deny rule tests with connectivity verification. It uses command-line utilities and UCI configurations and appears to be part of a testing or validation suite for firewall management in network devices.

methods.name: Detection of firewall variant
methods.description: Detects whether fw4 or fw3 is installed by checking command availability, and the status of the firewall service.

methods.name: Validate configuration syntax
methods.description: Runs firewall-specific validation commands depending on whether fw4 or fw3 is present, and reports configuration correctness.

methods.name: Zone defaults validation
methods.description: Checks UCI firewal zones (like lan and wan) for expected configurations.

methods.name: Temporary allow rule setup and testing
methods.description: Creates a temporary firewall rule to allow TCP traffic on a test port, then verifies connectivity from the local system, and cleans up afterward.

methods.name: Temporary deny rule setup and testing
methods.description: Creates a firewall rule to block TCP traffic on a test port, tests the blocked state, and then restores the previous configuration.
